verdict.rationale: Inline comments anchored to specific text or images in an item's description are a fair capability for a project-management tool like Shortcut, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents it. The closest item, Doc collaborators seeing proposed changes, is a suggestion feature for Docs, not inline commenting on item descriptions, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can comment directly on specific text or images within an item's description
